subject: Math
question_mathml: <math xmlns='http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML'><mtext>What is the value of the digit </mtext><mn>7</mn><mtext> in the number </mtext><mn>472</mn><mtext>?</mtext></math>
solution_mathml: <math xmlns='http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML'><mrow><mtext>Step 1: Identify the place value of the digit 7. It is in the tens place.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Step 2: The value of 7 in the tens place is 70.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Answer: 70</mtext></mrow></math>
question_text: What is the value of the digit 7 in the number 472?
solution_text: Step 1: Identify the place value of the digit 7. It is in the tens place. Step 2: The value of 7 in the tens place is 70. Answer: 70.

subject: Math
question_mathml: <math xmlns='http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML'><mtext>Which digit is in the hundreds place in the number </mtext><mn>819</mn><mtext>?</mtext></math>
solution_mathml: <math xmlns='http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML'><mrow><mtext>Step 1: Identify the place values in the number 819.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Step 2: 8 is in the hundreds place, 1 is in the tens place, and 9 is in the units place.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Answer: 8</mtext></mrow></math>
question_text: Which digit is in the hundreds place in the number 819?
solution_text: Step 1: Identify the place values in the number 819. Step 2: 8 is in the hundreds place, 1 is in the tens place, and 9 is in the units place. Answer: 8.

subject: Math
question_mathml: <math xmlns='http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML'><mtext>What is 'three hundred and forty-five' written as a number?</mtext></math>
solution_mathml: <math xmlns='http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML'><mrow><mtext>Step 1: 'Three hundred' means 300.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Step 2: 'Forty-five' means 45.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Step 3: Combine these values: 300 + 45 = 345.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Answer: 345</mtext></mrow></math>
question_text: What is 'three hundred and forty-five' written as a number?
solution_text: Step 1: 'Three hundred' means 300. Step 2: 'Forty-five' means 45. Step 3: Combine these values: 300 + 45 = 345. Answer: 345.
